example: I can't believe it's already December. Time flies!
origin: A common saying that describes how quickly time seems to pass, especially when we are having fun or are busy.

wrong_meanings.why_wrong: The idiom has nothing to do with insects or with clocks; it is about how fast time passes.
This is the opposite of the idiom, which means time passes quickly, not that it stops.
The idiom is not about punctuality or being on time; it describes the speed of time.

explanation: 'Time flies' means that time passes very quickly. We often say it when we notice that a long period, like a year or a holiday, has gone by faster than we expected.
